_about.purpose: Repeatable labelled dataset for measuring match quality against the real candidate profile (2026 B.Tech CSE grad, ~0.4 years experience, Python/FastAPI/Node backend, React/Next.js frontend, AWS/Docker/Kubernetes, LangChain/agentic-AI evaluation).

labels.relevant: Should be eligible and should rank in the upper band. A false negative here costs a real opportunity.
labels.irrelevant: Must NOT reach the high band. A false positive here wastes an application and is the failure mode this dataset exists to catch.
labels.adversarial: Irrelevant, but shares surface tokens or skills with the profile. These are the cases that expose naive token overlap.
labels.edge: Tests honesty of missing data, duplicates, and freshness rather than ranking.

_about.usage: tests/test_matching_eval.py loads this file, scores every row against a fixture profile built from the real resume, and asserts aggregate precision/recall plus per-row expectations.
